thread:
Harini P.: heads-up — found a pretty subtle bundler-induced failure hitting the JS SDK on our edge runner. filing the mini-repro here.
Harini P.: TL;DR: rollup + plugin-commonjs (or webpack with certain loaders) + a `sideEffects: false` package + mixed CJS/ES dep graph can cause the auth wrapper to be tree-shaken in the CJS output. result: edge picks CJS main -> outgoing requests 401 + runtime TypeError about missing method.
Dmitri V.: ugh. can you paste the exact symptoms you saw?
Harini P.: example runtime output on the edge: 
```
ERROR: outgoing SDK call failed: 401 Unauthorized
TypeError: client.createCompletion is not a function
    at file:///workspace/dist/index.js:58:16
    at async handle (edge:internal)
```
Harini P.: local ESM dev build (vite/esm or node --input-type=module) works fine. issue only triggers when the published package's CJS entrypoint is resolved by the deployer and the bundle has both CJS-shaped exports and some top-level unused helpers removed.
Zoe: wow, tree-shaking removed the auth helper? how does that happen?
Harini P.: repro case outline: sample app depends on SDK and also pulls in a tiny helper lib that is published with `sideEffects: false`. rollup + @rollup/plugin-commonjs converts that helper to CJS. during optimization, rollup/terser/prerollup think the auth wrapper is unused (the call site is indirect via `default` interop) and drop it in the cjs build because of an optimization/order issue. the final cjs bundle ends up not calling the internal fetch wrapper that attaches the Authorization header.
Samira: that's nasty and pretty fragile. which bundlers reproduce it?
Harini P.: reproduced with: (A) rollup + @rollup/plugin-commonjs (B) webpack 5 with module.rules using babel-loader + commonjs modules transformed (C) vite when it uses rollup under the hood for library mode and plugin-commonjs runs. esbuild-only builds are less likely but can still reproduce if `format:'cjs'` + mixed deps present.
Dmitri V.: do you have minimal repro steps?
Harini P.: yes — minimal:
1) git clone https://github.com/redwood-internal/repro-rollup-tree-shake (internal sampleapp)
2) npm ci
3) npm run build:rollup-cjs
4) deno task start:edge (or deploy to edge runner)
5) curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" http://localhost/_complete -> returns 401 and runtime TypeError shown above.
Harini P.: rollup config snippet that triggers:
```js
// rollup.config.js (lib build)
import commonjs from '@rollup/plugin-commonjs'
import nodeResolve from '@rollup/plugin-node-resolve'
export default {
  input: 'src/index.ts',
  output: { file: 'dist/cjs/index.js', format: 'cjs' },
  plugins: [
    nodeResolve({ preferBuiltins: false }),
    commonjs({ transformMixedEsModules: true })
  ]
}
```
Zoe: any chance this is just a packaging issue? what does package.json exports look like?
Harini P.: SDK package.json currently has `main` -> dist/cjs/index.js and `module` -> dist/esm/index.js but no conditional exports map. edge deployer prefers main for CJS compatibility, so the CJS path gets used. additionally some published helper libs marked `sideEffects:false` caused tree-shake to be aggressive.
Samira: typings impact for TS users?
Harini P.: yes — TS projects using `import SDK from '@redwood-inference/sdk'` compile but some strict consumers (no esModuleInterop) already import named exports; the runtime mismatch leads to confusing failures. Also the 401 makes it look like auth or platform issue rather than bundler. high onboarding friction.
Dmitri V.: what's the quick mitigation?
Harini P.: short-term fixes we tested: 1) Prefer ESM in packaging: add conditional exports so `import` paths resolve to ESM and edge deployer picks the module field. example: "exports": {"import": "./dist/esm/index.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js"}. 2) Add an explicit interop entry at package root that normalizes exports and forces the auth wrapper to be retained: small file `shim.cjs` that `const mod = require('./dist/cjs'); module.exports = mod && mod.__esModule ? mod.default : mod;` and set `main` to that shim while publishing. 3) Mark the auth wrapper file as side-effectful or reference it in a way bundlers won't remove it (avoid pure top-level unused exports). 4) Update onboarding/sampleapp build config to default to ESM library output and warn about `transformMixedEsModules` and `sideEffects:false` pitfalls.
Zoe: longer term we should fix packaging and add CI to prevent regressions.
Harini P.: Agreed. CI steps I added to the repro: build matrix (esm/cjs/mixed) + run tiny edge emulation to validate Authorization header is preserved and exported API shape matches expectation. CI artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/repro/rollup-tree-shake/ci/14 (internal).
Samira: any change needed on platform side? maybe edge deployer could prefer `exports.import` when present or at least warn if `main` is cjs and `module` exists.
bot-deploy: FYI: edge deployer currently prefers `main` for backwards compatibility. we've discussed switching to prefer `module`/`exports.import` but that requires coordination across many integrations. I'll raise a ticket.
Dmitri V.: action items: (1) Harini: open PR to add conditional exports + small interop shim as canary, add repro + CI job to devex docs (2) Samira: update sampleapp templates to ESM-first and add a short DX note about `sideEffects: false` packages and plugin-commonjs order (3) Platform: consider deployer warning about CJS main when module exists.
Harini P.: I'll open the PR with the reproducible failing CI job and proposed packaging patch. tagging the SDK owners and publishing team for quick canary. will ping when ready. :thumbsup:
